sources.title: The Confessions of Saint Augustine (tr. E. B. Pusey)
The Book of Enoch (tr. R. H. Charles, 1917)
sources.note: Canonical in the Ethiopian Orthodox Bible. Pinned: SPCK 1917 text (Global Grey 2013 e-book scan).

sources.title: The Kebra Nagast: The Queen of Sheba and her only son Menyelek (tr. E. A. Wallis Budge, 1922)
sources.note: Ethiopia's national epic, read in the Ethiopian Orthodox Church. Chapters found by numbered caps headings checked against the sequence; lost headings become ranges (Chapters 17-18).

sources.title: The Book of Jubilees (tr. R. H. Charles, 1917)
sources.note: Canonical in the Ethiopian Orthodox Bible. Chapters open with a roman numeral checked against the sequence; lost ones become ranges. Verse numbers are inline, so refs are by chapter.

sources.title: The Book of Adam and Eve, also called the Conflict of Adam and Eve with Satan (tr. S. C. Malan, 1882)
sources.archiveQuery: title:(book of adam and eve) AND creator:(malan)
sources.note: Translated from the Ethiopic (Gadla Adam). Four books of chapters; OCR numerals read against the sequence.

sources.title: The Miracles of the Blessed Virgin Mary (tr. E. A. Wallis Budge, 1900, from the Lady Meux Ethiopic manuscripts)
sources.archiveQuery: title:(miracles of the blessed virgin mary) AND creator:(budge)
sources.note: Ta'amra Maryam. Only the translated miracles are kept (not the salutations, the Life of Hanna, the magical prayers or the Ethiopic text). The 1933 '110 Miracles' is avoided: possibly still in US copyright.

sources.title: The Life of Takla Haymanot (tr. E. A. Wallis Budge, 1906, from the Dabra Libanos manuscript)
sources.archiveQuery: title:(life of takla haymanot) AND creator:(budge)
sources.note: Gadla Takla Haymanot, volume I: the Life in its 116 chapters. The plates, their captions and the page-foot notes are dropped.

sources.title: Baralam and Yewasef, the Ethiopic version of the Story of Barlaam and Josaphat (tr. E. A. Wallis Budge, 1923)
sources.note: Only the translated story is kept, from its first heading to the colophon; the introduction, the Acts of Thomas appendix and the plates are dropped. Sections are Budge's bracketed headings.

sources.title: Ephrem the Syrian, Three Homilies (tr. A. E. Johnston, NPNF II/13)
sources.license: Public domain (Schaff's Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, 1886-1900; CCEL marks it 'Rights: Public Domain')
sources.note: Plain text from CCEL (format name aside, any plain-text URL).

sources.title: Aphrahat, Select Demonstrations (tr. J. Gwynn, NPNF II/13)
sources.license: Public domain (Schaff's Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, 1886-1900; CCEL marks it 'Rights: Public Domain')

sources.title: Mystic Treatises by Isaac of Nineveh (tr. A. J. Wensinck, 1923)
sources.note: St. Isaac the Syrian, read across the Syriac, Ethiopian, Coptic and Eastern Orthodox churches. Treatise numerals are OCR-mangled; read against the sequence, missing ones become ranges.

sources.title: The Discourses of Philoxenus, Bishop of Mabbogh (tr. E. A. Wallis Budge, 1894), vol. II
sources.note: Volume II, the English translation of the thirteen discourses on the Christian life; the introduction and the Syriac scriptural collations are dropped. Philoxenus is a father of the Syriac Orthodox Church.

sources.title: Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture II: On Repentance (NPNF II/7)
sources.license: Public domain (Schaff's Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, 1886-1900; CCEL marks it 'Rights: Public Domain')

sources.title: John Chrysostom, Letters to Theodore after his Fall (NPNF I/9)
sources.license: Public domain (Schaff's Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, 1886-1900; CCEL marks it 'Rights: Public Domain')

sources.title: Athanasius, Life of Antony (tr. H. Ellershaw, NPNF II/4)
sources.license: Public domain (Schaff's Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, 1886-1900; CCEL marks it 'Rights: Public Domain')

sources.title: The Book of the Saints of the Ethiopian Church (tr. E. A. Wallis Budge, 1928)
sources.archiveQuery: title:(book of the saints of the ethiopian church) AND creator:(budge)
sources.license: Public domain in the US (published 1928) and in life+70 countries (Budge d. 1934)
sources.note: Pinned: vol. I (Maskaram-Hedar) from the 0001sire scan + Columbia microfilm for the remaining volumes (starts at Takhsas).

sources.title: The Paradise or Garden of the Holy Fathers (tr. E. A. Wallis Budge, 1907)
sources.archiveQuery: title:(paradise holy fathers) AND (creator:(budge) OR creator:(palladius) OR creator:(athanasius))
sources.note: Pinned: two-volume 1907 Chatto & Windus English edition; verify heads in report.md.

sources.title: The Lausiac History of Palladius (tr. W. K. Lowther Clarke, 1918)
sources.license: Public domain in the US only (published 1918). Translator d. 1968: NOT PD in life+70 countries until 2039. Serve from US hosting only.
sources.note: Pinned: University of Toronto scan of the 1918 Clarke translation.
